ranked.headline: Representation learning that imputes, denoises, and aligns incomplete single-cell data
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial measurements are often incomplete, confounded, or weakly labeled, so representations must remain usable under these conditions.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking whether biological sequence models capture genome and structure features
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether general LLMs and DNA and protein models handle raw genomes, chromatin structure, and generated distributions.

ranked.headline: Spatial context enters single-cell models of gene regulation and cell communication
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers add spatial geometry, chromatin accessibility and benchmarking to single-cell and spatial communication and regulatory inference.

ranked.headline: Testing when structural and target context improves biomolecular prediction and design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers test whether explicit structural or target context improves prediction, benchmarking conformational fidelity directly.

ranked.headline: Biologically grounded LLM agents automate single-cell and spatial omics analysis
ranked.summary: Agentic LLM systems now couple structured biological evidence with multi-step reasoning, and new benchmarks test where they succeed.

ranked.headline: Calibrating mechanistic biological models, now with LLM-assisted construction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply uncertainty quantification and LLM-assisted workflows to calibrate mechanistic cancer and metabolic models.

ranked.headline: Graph transformers and GNNs predict molecular and protein interactions
ranked.summary: Recent work extends graph learning to ADR, PFAS binding and glycan modeling, while a leakage-free benchmark tempers sequence-representation claims.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks expose count distortion by ambient RNA tools in single-cell pipelines
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks test processing tools directly for failure modes, alongside adaptive QC and containerized pipeline designs.

ranked.headline: Structured biomedical evidence resources are being built and tested with LLM pipelines
ranked.summary: Recent preprints combine LLM text mining with curated databases to make biomedical evidence queryable and checkable.

ranked.headline: Raw-read learning and benchmarking reshape microbial genomics analysis pipelines
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair raw-read models with pipeline benchmarks spanning metagenomic, amplicon, and single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Genomic language and deep models are tested for mechanistic learning and transfer
ranked.summary: Interpretability and out-of-distribution robustness are now assessed as primary outcomes alongside aggregate accuracy in genomic machine learning models.

ranked.headline: Generative models for patient care trajectories in continuous time
ranked.summary: Small longitudinal cohorts and sparse clinical event logs motivate generative models that handle irregular timing and rare events.

ranked.headline: Explicit specifications for dependencies, library designs, and model encodings
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication describe tools that make environments, DNA library designs, and SBML models explicit and portable.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks show sequencing technology and coverage shape human variant detection accuracy
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and callers address how sequencing technology, coverage and tumour-only context affect variant calls.

ranked.headline: Models resolve disorder, amyloid nucleation, and conformational landscapes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study apply coarse-grained, FD-MD, latent-space, and generative methods to disordered, amyloid, and conformational states.

ranked.headline: Packaged tools make genomics outputs portable, inspectable and interactive
ranked.summary: Recent releases package end-to-end workflows and result visualization into self-contained, reusable software rather than new algorithms.

ranked.headline: Genomic position and 3D context shape regulatory element activity and gene expression
ranked.summary: Recent work links chromosomal position, temporal co-accessibility, and 3D genome data to regulatory element activity and gene expression.

ranked.headline: ML models predict inhibitor cardiotoxicity, resistance, and chemical toxicity endpoints
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply supervised learning to kinome, molecular dynamics, QSAR, and expression data for prediction and prioritization.

ranked.headline: Unified datasets and repeat-aware pipelines make multi-omics outputs reusable
ranked.summary: Recent releases package unified spatial, imaging and repeat-element outputs for reuse, while cross-cohort generalisability remains limited.

ranked.headline: Simulation and AlphaFold models resolve receptor states that shape ligand recognition
ranked.summary: Microsecond MD, AlphaFold models and adaptive sampling now resolve receptor and channel conformations that bear on ligand recognition and inhibitor design.

ranked.headline: Spatial and temporal structure set ecological network robustness and disease endemicity
ranked.summary: Explicit spatial and temporal structure now governs predicted outcomes in ecological and epidemic network models.

ranked.headline: Inferring selection, variant effect and genomic prediction from population genomes
ranked.summary: Recent methods combine multiplexed assay data, interpretable machine learning, and selection tests to refine variant and trait inference.

ranked.headline: Transformer fusion of H&E slides and bulk expression flags premalignant lung dysplasia
ranked.summary: Transformer fusion of whole-slide images and bulk expression is now paired with benchmarking and cross-species pretraining in genomic deep learning.

ranked.headline: Statistical methods for temporal omics, single-cell dependence and sequence encoding
ranked.summary: Recovering temporal and dependence structure from omics data demands statistics that handle complex designs, sparse counts, and shape constraints.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics across taxa links gene duplication to lineage-specific innovation
ranked.summary: New high-quality genomes and phylogenomic analyses allow direct comparison of duplication and transfer across distant taxa.

ranked.headline: Transfer of energetic and learned models to polymers and non-canonical cyclic peptides
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication extend energetic and learned models to polypeptoids, cyclic peptides, and nonstandard residues beyond training regimes.

ranked.headline: Residue-level structure descriptors link dynamics, viral interface evolution, and design
ranked.summary: Recent items pair residue contact maps, MD mutagenesis, and language models with viral interface evolution and nucleic acid therapeutic design.

ranked.headline: Statistical frameworks attribute correlated GWAS and TWAS associations to causal genes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication extend association-based gene prioritization to pleiotropy, multicollinearity, and phenotype correlation.

ranked.headline: Multi-omic and transcriptomic representations link brain cell types to disease
ranked.summary: Aged brain multi-omics integration and proposed foundation-model approaches aim to tie molecular features to cell types and disease.

ranked.headline: Diffusion and language models generate molecules conditioned on pockets and 3D shape
ranked.summary: Generative models now condition on flexible pocket conformations, 3D shape, and functional group counts to guide de novo design.

ranked.headline: Automated pipelines now segment and quantify cells, plankton and DNA fibers in microscopy
ranked.summary: Full-resolution and whole-slide images make manual annotation costly, motivating open-source automated workflows that reduce manual labelling.

ranked.headline: Ion Pump and Channel Models Probe Energetics, Noise, and Metal Block
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a 2026 study apply thermodynamic, quantum-structural, and MD approaches to ion pump and channel function.

ranked.headline: Models show noise and scale shape mosquito-borne outbreak dynamics in urban settings
ranked.summary: April 2026 preprint and publications link temporal scale, stochastic noise, and human mobility to arboviral and measles epidemic patterns.

ranked.headline: Faster tools for protein dynamics: CEST fitting, flexibility, trajectory compression
ranked.summary: Analysis and storage costs for protein dynamics data are being reduced at individual workflow stages by new web and file-format tools.

ranked.headline: Physically informed models for docking, force fields, and aqueous pKa prediction
ranked.summary: Three April 2026 items embed physical knowledge into molecular modeling, from annealer-based docking to reduced-reference force field training.

ranked.headline: LPS-phospholipid separation and polymer crossing in Gram-negative outer membrane models
ranked.summary: Recent coarse-grained simulations resolve how outer membrane lipid organization and polymer adhesion govern molecular partitioning across the envelope.

ranked.headline: Titer statistics and binding models infer antibody and mRNA delivery parameters
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply extreme value theory, deep learning, and equilibrium binding models to quantify immune and delivery parameters from measured data.
